items.text_th: ขายเหมาโสมธรรมดา 20 ต้น 200บาท สนใจทักครับ
items.text_vn: Bán trọn 20 cây nhân sâm thường 200 baht, ai quan tâm inbox nhé.
items.summary_vn: Bán 20 cây nhân sâm thường giá 200 baht
items.text_vn_machine: Bán 20 cây nhân sâm bình thường với giá 200 baht. Nếu quan tâm, hãy nói chuyện với chúng tôi.
items.text_en: Selling a bundle of 20 normal ginseng for 200 baht, DM if interested.

items.text_th: ผมเล่นมาหลายปีแล้ว มีแต่เพื่อนที่ดีๆ แล้วเกมนี้จะให้ทำอะไรเยอะ
items.text_vn: Mình chơi mấy năm rồi, toàn gặp bạn tốt, mà game này có nhiều thứ để làm lắm.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi lâu năm khen bạn bè tốt, game nhiều hoạt động.
items.text_en: I've played for years and always meet good friends, and this game has lots of things to do.
items.summary_en: Long-time player praises good friends and lots of activities.

items.text_th: บัญชีหาย. บัญชีหายหมด เติมไปหลักหมื่น
items.text_vn: Mất tài khoản. Tài khoản mất sạch, đã nạp cả chục nghìn baht.
items.summary_vn: Mất tài khoản đã nạp hàng chục nghìn baht.
items.text_en: Lost account. My account is completely gone, I'd topped up tens of thousands of baht.
items.summary_en: Lost an account with tens of thousands of baht in top-ups.
